mapper.sql: select id, uid, mid, symbol, balance, frozen, create_time, update_time from p_merchant_asset
select a.id, a.uid, a.mid, a.symbol, a.balance, a.frozen, a.create_time, a.update_time, l.account, b.pid from p_merchant_asset a left join u_login l on a.uid = l.uid and l.type in (3)
